lines.zh: 我这身方壳，转弯很费劲。
lines.en: In this boxy shell, turning takes effort.

lines.zh: 我划得慢，壳先到，我才到。
lines.en: I paddle slowly; the shell arrives first.

lines.zh: 温水海洋的沙地上，我一格一格挪。
lines.en: Across lukewarm seabed I shift block by block.

lines.zh: 别催，我天生就这个速度。
lines.en: Do not rush me; this is my natural speed.

lines.zh: 壳边蹭过珊瑚，刮出白痕。
lines.en: My shell edge scrapes the coral white.
Only one companion swims beside me.
Deep water presses against my shell.

lines.zh: 我靠鳍尖一点点往前推。
lines.en: I push forward with the tips of my fins.

lines.zh: 石头在前面，我早看见了。
lines.en: There is a rock ahead; I saw it early.

lines.zh: 这个壳浮力刚好，不多不少。
lines.en: This shell has just the right buoyancy.

lines.zh: 我绕不过去，只好撞开海草。
lines.en: I cannot go around, so I barge the weeds.
The water cools; I sink a little deeper.

lines.zh: 方壳在水里晃，像块石头。
lines.en: My box shell sways like a loose stone.

lines.zh: 我身后的沙被搅成一片雾。
lines.en: The sand behind me rises like fog.

lines.zh: 一群同伴在前头，我跟在末尾
lines.en: The school is ahead; I trail at the back.

lines.zh: 海草摇晃，我借着它往前推
lines.en: The kelp sways, and I push along with it.

lines.zh: 我停在水里，壳自己稳住了。
lines.en: I stop; the shell steadies itself.
A square stone that happens to breathe.

lines.zh: 温水泡着我的接缝，很舒服。
lines.en: Warm water soaks my seams pleasantly.
I stare at the little scratches on my shell.
My companion is on my left, also still.
The deep water is dark and very quiet.

lines.zh: 我不用躲，谁咬我都吃亏。
lines.en: I need not hide; biting me costs them.

lines.zh: 壳里闷，我把水从鳃挤出去。
lines.en: It is stuffy; I push water through my gills.

lines.zh: 有一层薄沙落在我背上。
lines.en: A thin layer of sand settled on my back.

lines.zh: 我在等潮水把方向换一换。
lines.en: I wait for the tide to turn and push me.

lines.zh: 这条裂缝正好卡住我的边角。
lines.en: This crevice fits my corner exactly.

lines.zh: 慢下来以后，海就变大了。
lines.en: When I slow down, the sea grows larger.

lines.zh: 我听见鲸群在很远的地方。
lines.en: I hear whales somewhere very far away.

lines.zh: 一分钟，我只眨了一下眼。
lines.en: In a whole minute I blinked once.

lines.zh: 你在上面漂着，我看见你的腿。
lines.en: You float above; I see your legs kicking.

lines.zh: 你潜下来，鼻子差点碰到我的壳。
lines.en: You dive; your nose nearly meets my shell.
Do not tap the shell; someone lives inside.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，只抬得动一点。
lines.en: I lift my head, only slightly.

lines.zh: 你在我眼里是竖着的一条。
lines.en: To me you are one long vertical shape.
Are you counting the ridges on my shell?
I know the glint of a diving mask.

lines.zh: 你伸手了，我往旁边挪半格。
lines.en: Your hand comes; I shift half a block aside.

lines.zh: 我的眼珠小，看得很清楚。
lines.en: Small eyes, but nothing escapes them.

lines.zh: 你最好别把我捞进桶里。
lines.en: You had better not scoop me into a bucket.

lines.zh: 敲到接缝了，那是最软的地方。
lines.en: You struck a seam; that is my softest place.
A hairline crack crosses my shell.

lines.zh: 疼，可我没什么肉可以伤。
lines.en: It hurts, though I have little flesh to wound.
I cannot pull in; I am too wide.
One hit and I am on my back.
I right myself slowly, with great effort.
My fin is pinned under my shell.
Who is knocking on my house?
The blood in the water makes me sick.
All I can do is sink and hide.
That lump in your hand is moving.
I am not picky about food, but water.
That smell warms even my shell.

lines.zh: 我游近一点，又不敢太近。
lines.en: I drift closer, but not too close.

lines.zh: 你放下的东西沉在沙上。
lines.en: What you dropped settles on the sand.
My companion sniffs, then backs away.
I open up, swallow, and chew slowly.
Shrimp or crab? Either will do.

lines.zh: 我往前顶了一下，没够到。
lines.en: I nudge forward and miss the food.
Hold your hand still; I cannot aim.

lines.zh: 你碰我一下，手指就发麻。
lines.en: Touch me and your fingers go numb.
My shell is hard; a knock will not crack it.

lines.zh: 你把我顶得转了四分之一圈。
lines.en: You spun me a quarter turn.
I bump back like hitting a brick.

lines.zh: 同伴被我挤到珊瑚后面。
lines.en: I shove my companion behind the coral.

lines.zh: 棱角磕到石头，响了一声。
lines.en: A ridge strikes stone with a knock.

lines.zh: 我散出的东西，你别沾到手。
lines.en: Do not get what I leak on your hand.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的方向全乱了。
lines.en: That hit scrambled my sense of direction.
Back away slowly; I cannot turn around.

lines.zh: 壳上的划痕又多了一道。
lines.en: One more scratch on the shell.

lines.zh: 我找到另一只方的，就她了。
lines.en: I found another box; she will do.

lines.zh: 我们的棱角正好对得上。
lines.en: Our ridges line up exactly.

lines.zh: 水里就我们两个，很清静。
lines.en: Just the two of us in the water.
She turns a bit more nimbly than I do.

lines.zh: 我用鳍碰了碰她的壳边。
lines.en: I touch the rim of her shell with a fin.

lines.zh: 这一窝只会孵出两三条。
lines.en: This brood will hatch only two or three.
We sink side by side into the rock gap.
She tastes bitter too, I can tell.
Stay back; we are guarding the eggs.
She presses against my shell and stills.

lines.zh: 我用嘴顶起一块小石子。
lines.en: I lever up a pebble with my mouth.
This thing is squarer than I am.
It wedges between two of my ridges.
I push it along half a block.
One bite: hard, and not food.

lines.zh: 骨粉的味道让我打了个嗝。
lines.en: The bonemeal smell makes me hiccup.
This iron scrap is too slick to hold.
I flip it over to see the back.
Whatever is buried in the sand is mine.
Never mind; I drop it and swim on.
Something big is moving up ahead.
A net is coming down from above.
That fish has been following me.
There is blood, and none of it mine.
The pressure changed; something is near.
Two bootprints appeared on the seabed.

lines.zh: 我盯住那条晃动的绳子。
lines.en: I fix on the swaying rope above.
A shark, or only a shadow?
My companion has pulled into its shell.
Slowly, I swing my whole box around.
I face it squarely and hold still.
It circles; I stay put and wait.
My poison did not grow for nothing.

lines.zh: 再近一点，它就碰我的壳。
lines.en: One step closer and it meets my shell.
I lower my head and draw it in.
I know exactly how far off it is.
If it opens its mouth, it is finished.

lines.zh: 我身上的味道已经散出去了。
lines.en: My scent is already spreading through the water.

lines.zh: 同伴在我后面，让它先走。
lines.en: My companion is behind me; let it go first.
The first move belongs to it.
I ram my head into its mouth.
It bit me and broke a tooth.
My shell rim splits its skin.
I need not bite; a ram is enough.
Its mouth is going numb now.
I pull back and let it hurt.
The blow shoved me off my line.
My ridge digs into its fin.
It lets go and swims away.
Do not taste me, I warned you.
I float up from the black water.

lines.zh: 这片温水，比我出生的地方浅。
lines.en: This lukewarm shelf is shallower than my birthplace.
My plates have not hardened; I keep low.

lines.zh: 只有一条同伴跟我上来。
lines.en: Only one companion rose with me.
The water below is black as night.

lines.zh: 我撞到一块珊瑚，停住了。
lines.en: I bump a coral head and stop.

lines.zh: 光从上面落下来，一条一条。
lines.en: Light falls from above in long strips.
I try to turn and fail.
The sand here is warmer than the deep.

lines.zh: 我慢慢找一块石头靠着。
lines.en: I slowly find a stone to lean on.
My shell is heating up; it may split.

lines.zh: 壳先落地，里面震得发晕。
lines.en: Shell first; the shock leaves me dizzy.

lines.zh: 我在水里，怎么会喘不上气。
lines.en: I am in water; why can I not breathe?

lines.zh: 冲击把我的壳推得凹进去。
lines.en: The blast dented my shell inward.
The arrowhead is stuck between my ridges.

lines.zh: 魔法的光进了壳缝，烧起来。
lines.en: Magic light got into my seams and burned.

lines.zh: 沙底连一只小蟹都没有。
lines.en: Not a single small crab on the sand.

lines.zh: 雷顺着海水钻进了我的壳。
lines.en: Lightning rode the seawater into my shell.
The shell remains, but the sea is gone.
